candidate.one_line: From Ideas `harvest-classic-keltner-chesler`. Trade closes crossing outside an EMA(20) +/- k ATR(10) channel; ATR trailing stop; reverse on opposite signal. Source: Chester Keltner (1960), How to Make Money in Commodities.
